Logging setup, timestamps, IDs, signal handlers, and boot/halt support.

# Purpose
This file implements the POSIX version of the `fd_log` subsystem. It provides the core logging state and public entry points for application, thread, host, CPU, group, and user identity data, plus wallclock time, sleep, and wait helpers used by the logger. It also defines the boot and halt flow for the logging system, including command-line and environment parsing, default value setup, log file open and close, deduplication control, color output control, and signal handler setup for trapped faults and aborts.

The file also contains the message formatting and output path for log records. It writes log lines to a permanent log file and to `stderr`, supports optional color escape codes, and can suppress repeated messages with a deduplication scheme. It includes helper functions for formatted log strings, hexdump text, backtrace logging when available, and cleanup logic for exit and signal cases. In addition, it contains stack discovery helpers used for thread stack diagnostics on POSIX systems.
